_comment: Recommended judge settings per vision model. Choosing a model in Settings fills these in (the first preset that fits both the backend in use and the model name wins; a preset without 'backends' fits any). 'prompt_token_budget' is an absolute cap on the judge prompt: long-context accuracy starts dropping around 10-20% of a model's window and the middle of a long prompt is recalled worst, so prompts are kept short and the key parts sit at the start and end.

presets.label: DeepSeek V4 Flash (DeepInfra)
presets.notes: Hosted vision model: nothing to load locally, several calls can run at once, and a judged round costs a fraction of a cent. It reasons before answering, so leave room for the answer (max_tokens 8192). Temperature 0 keeps the same image's score stable between looks, which is what makes the pass threshold mean anything.

presets.label: Qwen3-VL (thinking)
presets.notes: Thinks before answering: 100-270 s per judge call in tests, and at temperature 0 it loops until num_predict. Prefer an -instruct tag.

presets.label: Qwen3-VL instruct
presets.notes: Temperature 0: judging the same image twice moved the score by 0.3-0.5 points, against 8-10 points at 0.7, at the same speed (measured with python -m ouroboros eval). A stable score is what makes the threshold mean something.

presets.label: Qwen2.5-VL
presets.notes: Temperature 0: judging the same image twice moved the score by 0.3-0.5 points, against 8-10 points at 0.7, at the same speed (measured with python -m ouroboros eval). A stable score is what makes the threshold mean something.

presets.label: Llama 3.2 Vision
presets.notes: One image per message, so the reference and candidates go as one grid (up to 1120 px). Older uploads such as Drews54/llama3.2-vision-abliterated don't load in Ollama 0.34+.

presets.label: Gemma 3
presets.notes: Several images per message; Google's recommended sampling.

presets.label: OpenAI
presets.notes: Large window; the budget still keeps prompts short and cheap.

presets.label: DeepInfra hosted model
presets.notes: Generic settings for a hosted vision model. Check the model's page for its context window and whether it reasons before answering (which needs a larger max_tokens).
